title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — November 05, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B4.9)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.1 (Peaked November 05, 2026 at 02:18 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 363 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Everything looks pretty calm. 💛

A broad dark EUV region and several bright coronal structures are visible today, while sunspot coverage remains limited.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 211/193/171 Å Composite
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
